title: tanacetum corymbosum subsp. cinereum
intro: Tanacetum corymbosum subsp. cinereum, commonly known as Grey Pyrethrum, is a plant species belonging to the daisy family (Asteraceae) and is native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions such as digestive issues, skin problems, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Grey Pyrethrum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, that have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. Regular consumption or application of Tanacetum corymbosum subsp. cinereum has been associated with improved health outcomes due to its ability to modulate the immune system and reduce oxidative stress.
